“Behold, he will come up like a lion from the pride of the Jordan against the strong habitation: for I will suddenly…

translations.web: But they were exceedingly afraid, and said, “Behold, the two kings didn’t stand before him! How then shall we stand?”
translations.bsb: But they were terrified and reasoned, “If two kings could not stand against him, how can we?”
translations.kjv: But they were exceedingly afraid, and said, Behold, two kings stood not before him: how then shall we stand?
